title: Probability Representation of Quantum States: Tomographic Representation in Standard Potentials And Peres–Horodecki Criterion for Probabilities
content:
In connection with the International Year of Quantum Science and Technology, a
review of joint works of the Lebedev Institute and different Mexican research
groups is presented; specially related to solving the old problem of the state
description not only by wave functions but also by conventional probability
distributions analogous to quasiprobability distributions like the Wigner
function. Also, explicit expressions of tomographic representations describing
the quantum states of particles moving in known potential wells are obtained
and briefly discussed. In particular, we present the examples of the
tomographic distributions for the free evolution, finite and infinite
potential wells, and the Morse potential. Additional to this, an extension of
the Peres--Horodecki separability criteria for momentum probability
distributions is presented in the case of bipartite, asymmetrical, real
states.
